per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay/experiment rows were reconciled to Table 1 and Figure 1; exact matches are source_verified, while the Sp6 U87 value mismatch and DRAMP database-only/conflicting labels remain source_conflict.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity now records all 32 Table 1 IC50 rows with µM units, human cancer cell-line targets, method locators, and database traceability. No toxicity/hemolysis values are invented because the paper does not report them.

per_layer_decision_rationale.review_layer: Open ticket rwk-complete-test-0001 is closed because the previous framework-only/database-conflict blocker has been replaced by paper-specific source-reviewed adjudication and nonblocking cautions.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary Table 1 gives A4K14-citropin1.1-6 U87 IC50 as 34.49 µM; linked DBAASP assay/experiment rows report 34.50 µM. Final activity uses 34.49 and both database rows remain source_conflict.

Several DRAMP rows add antimicrobial labels or target/value text not tested in this paper; DRAMP35750/35751 also contain DOI/value/target conflicts. These rows are preserved as source_conflict and not promoted to source_verified.
Data_Sheet_1.docx supplies HPLC/HRMS spectra and structure support for synthesized peptides; it does not add separate activity/toxicity tables beyond Table 1.
The paper contains migration phenotypes and SAR/stability evidence, but the cell-membrane mechanism is explicitly treated as a hypothesis rather than direct mechanism evidence.
